ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious scheduled task creation events. Based on attributes such as paths, commands line flags, etc. Note: Unmapped fields: TaskContent

sequences.query: (event_id = 4698 AND (TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*")) AND (TaskContent = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\<\\/Command\\>.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*cmd\\<\\/Command\\>.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\<Arguments\\>\\/c\\ .*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\<Arguments\\>\\/k\\ .*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*\\<Arguments\\>\\/r\\ .*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*pwsh.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*certutil.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*bitsadmin.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*bash\\\.exe.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*bash\\ .*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*scrcons.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*wmic\\ .*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*wmic\\\.exe.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*forfiles.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*scriptrunner.*") OR TaskContent = RGX(".*hh\\\.exe.*")))
